title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode3 Familiar Faces

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: The next morning
School trip - Day two

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yawn... I'm still pretty sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My legs still hurt from having to sit on my feet after getting caught. Honestly, this is going to haunt me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's time to get back to business!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Because this is day two!
We're free to spend the day however we like!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today, we'll be visiting Kiyomizu-dera Temple, and then seeing the Hyakki Yako Parade, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's the plan!
We'll also have some time before the parade to look for souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miyake and the others said that they'd like to meet up before the parade begins. Would you mind them joining us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They sounded very interested after I told them that I'd be seeing it with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
The more the merrier I say!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, you all chatted up a storm during our game of cards last night! I can say now that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've made some wonderful new friends, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm also glad.
It's been quite a while since I had fun with my classmates like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, here's the bus for Kiyomizu-dera Temple!
Let's get on, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay.
Kiyomizu-dera Temple

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow☆ This place is amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But, is this really a stage?
Aren't there seats for the audience somewhere?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, no seats are necessary.
Especially since this is where one is supposed to perform for the temple's principal image.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The principal... Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A statue of a very wise person who lived long ago and reached a state of pure enlightenment. It's over there. You face towards it when you perform.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Cool!
So you get to do shows for a statue!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! And if you look over there, you get a spectacular view of all of Kyoto!

rows.Speaker: Len, Rin & Miku
rows.Line: <Wooow!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for agreeing to Miku and the others' request during your trip, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's my pleasure.
Please let us know if there's anything you'd like to see as well, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I appreciate the offer...
But...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We should probably head back soon since there's quite a crowd here. We wouldn't want any of them to see us by accident.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah.
Rui, we want you and Tsukasa to have lots and lots of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What he said!
Oh, but you guys have to tell us all about what you did later♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<What she said!
So, enjoy your trip, you two!
We hope you make lots of fun memories together☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
We'll see you again in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay♪ Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was brief, but I'm glad we had a chance to show Miku and the others what Kyoto looks like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As am I! I'm sure we'll have plenty of stories to tell them, but we should get them some of those famed mutsuhashi as a little gift!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

Airi, Asahina, look!
It's so big!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That voice I just heard sounded awfully familiar...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it's very beautiful.
I can see why this is a World Heritage Site. The temple looks so solidly built.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And this view!
Wait, are you taking another video?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'm going to tell Minori and the others all about how our trip's going and... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
The screen just went black...
I wonder what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hang on... Don't tell me you've only been taking videos since this morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is that bad?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course it's bad!
Your battery's probably totally drained!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I brought a portable charger for this trip, but I unfortunately lent it to another classmate this morning... Do you happen to have one, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I left mine behind.
I didn't think we'd be streaming or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What should I do...?!
Minori sounded so excited about hearing how our trip is going...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I'll take a few videos here and there for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You will?!
Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means I need to remember as much as I can about what we see and do so I can tell Minori and the others later...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you're...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I thought it was you, Shizuku! Your mask threw me off at first...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, with Airi Momoi in tow!
Oh, and you... We met during Shibuya Festa and New Year's...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Her name's Asahina, Tsukasa.
What brings you all to Kyoto?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We're here for our school trip.
Are you two as well, Kamishiro...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Miya Girls is also here for a school trip?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What a coincidence...!
I never thought we'd see you two here, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You two must be very close to call each other by your first names.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because our little sisters are incredibly close!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still... Hehe. This is quite the chance encounter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you all know where you'll be visiting next?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're free until the tour we signed up for this afternoon, so the three of us were thinking about visiting the shrine for the performing arts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a shrine for the performing arts...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's supposed to be dedicated to the deity of entertainment and the performing arts. Shizuku and I are idols after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We invited Asahina to join us and she said yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A shrine for the performing arts you say?! That sounds wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you two have plans after this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were planning on walking around and buying some souvenirs for now. Later this evening, we'll be seeing a parade called the Hyakki Yako Parade where people dress up as folkloric spirits!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Folkloric spirits...?
That sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree...!
I'd like to see it since it sounds like a wonderful event to see in Kyoto.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've set aside some time this evening to go buy souvenirs, so we could conceivably join you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Shizuku, your group is about to visit that shrine... And our group will be seeing the parade later tonight...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we do both together?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, you think we should merge groups...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Us meeting feels like more than just a coincidence! So, would you mind if we joined you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, if you'd like some privacy, we'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't think we mind...
But weren't you guys gonna go look for souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
We seem to have given ourselves more time than we needed to see Kiyomizu-dera Temple, so we can just see what's available along the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, let's go together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, also... Some friends will be joining us for the parade if that's alright with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, we're just students here to enjoy our school trip. Let's just try to have fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It looks like this will be a fun day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, we're set to go!
Thank you, Shizuku, Asahina, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why are you only calling me by my full name?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, so... Saki always used to shout, “It's Happy Everyday!” whenever she saw you, so I began remembering that as your name...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order to overwrite that, I've made it a habit to call you by your full name. I apologize if that feels awkward in any way...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I had no idea...
In that case, I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, keep your voice down!
Have you forgotten that I'm an idol?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, Tenma, it feels like I'm on a variety show whenever I talk to you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, thank you all for having us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Likewise, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's have as much fun as we can today!

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
